Major Taylor Cycling Club Chicago Big Ring

Tinley Park, IL · Road

Major Taylor Cycling Club Chicago Big Ring is a road group ride in Tinley Park, IL. It rolls every Tuesday at 5:30 pm from Bartel Grasslands.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 17–18 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @majortaylorchi the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Major Taylor Cycling Club Chicago Big Ring group ride

MTC3's signature Tuesday paceline ride in the south suburbs. A group drops, B group holds together if you keep the pace. The club, named for the first Black world cycling champion, runs rides nearly every day of the week from the South Side and suburbs, including a weekday Sunrise ride and a slower Tuesday Slow Your Roll.
